dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Oh, that? It's an honorific we use for researchers. Unfortunately, I do not yet have the qualifications to be a Dastur.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: I'm still an ordinary traveling scholar from the Aramati, so I'm often sent out to conduct filed research.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: If I make Dastur, then I might be able to stay at the Akademiya more often.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: And when that time comes, I might be able to join such luminaries as the great Pursina and the sagacious Ayesha, and bestow my name upon the fruits of my research, to be used by future generations...
